The controls only cover levels, and a linear projection cannot reach second moments. Sign -1: long the stable end (vol-of-vol, Baltussen et al. 2018). 16 seeds: coefficients of variation (windows 5/20), semideviations of log changes, the M3 structures divided by matching powers of RV level, cross_corr in place of cross_cov, and a scale-free version of M3's semivariance structure. Also 4 pre-registered controls on non-volatility raw inputs (kurtosis CV, daily-amount CV, log-volume-shape stddev, vol-amount corr), which I expect to fail.

The cleanest sources in this seed are all scale-invariant (log intraday volume distribution, kurtosis, regression t-value), and every control is a level, so scale-free statistics are orthogonal to the controls by construction. 11 seeds: ts_reg_tvalue(day_flat_run_max(Vwap), day_durbin_watson(Volume), 100/200) (t@100 known +1.14; dropped twice by R's rho gate; skeleton not in library), minute-level RSJ div(day_wmean(Ret,Ret), day_std(Ret)) daily and 20d, raw day_wmean(Ret,Ret), weekly skew, es_ratio_hi/lo(Ret), close/daily-VWAP 20d mean, top-volume-minute return over vol, es_ratio_hi(Volume) 20d.
